opportunities.title: Cara's Fellowship Programme
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individual academics at risk in their home country or recently displaced, regardless of nationality, from any country or continent, who are being forced to flee by the risk of imminent imprisonment, injury or death. Aims to secure temporary postdoctoral or PhD placements.
opportunities.summary: Rescue fellowship programme placing academics in immediate danger into temporary refuge at universities and research institutions (mostly in the UK, sometimes elsewhere), providing fee waivers, additional funding from Cara's own resources, visa help and practical support until they can return home. Fellowships are typically 2- or 3-year awards.
